stem.en: Pollen from a flower on one mustard plant lands on the stigma of a flower on a second mustard plant. What has happened?

text.en: Fertilisation, because pollen reached a stigma

feedback.en: Fertilisation is the later fusion of gametes in the ovule. Here pollen has only landed.

text.en: Self-pollination, because both plants are mustard

feedback.en: Self-pollination stays within one plant. Here there are two plants.

text.en: Germination, because a seed has reached the soil

feedback.en: No seed is involved here. A pollen grain has landed on a stigma.
Yes. The pollen went from one plant to another plant of the same type.

explanation.en: Pollen reaching a stigma is pollination. Because it came from another plant of the same type, it is cross-pollination. Fertilisation comes later, inside the ovule.

hints.en: Has anything happened inside the ovule yet?
